faqs.question: What is Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: Devfest Siliguri is a one-day tech conference organized by Google Developers Group Siliguri. It is a great opportunity for developers of all levels to learn about the latest technologies and trends, and to network with other developers in the community.

faqs.question: When is Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: Devfest Siliguri will be held on November 14, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the venue for Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: Devfest Siliguri will be held at ITC Fortune Select Siliguri.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to attend Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: Event tickets were sold in different phases in different price ranges.

faqs.question: Who is organizing Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: Devfest Siliguri is being organized by Google Developers Group Siliguri.

faqs.question: What is the schedule for Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: A detailed schedule for Devfest Siliguri will be posted on our website closer to the event date.

faqs.question: What kind of talks and workshops will be happening at Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: We will have a variety of talks and workshops on a variety of topics, including web development, mobile development, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

faqs.question: What should I bring to Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: You should bring your laptop, charger, and a notebook. You may also want to bring a business card to exchange with other attendees.

faqs.question: Is there a code of conduct for Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is a code of conduct for Devfest Siliguri. All attendees are expected to be respectful of each other and to create a welcoming and inclusive environment.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of attending the paid version of Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: The paid version of Devfest Siliguri includes access to all of the talks and workshops, as well as food and drinks. You will also receive a Devfest Siliguri t-shirt and swags.

faqs.question: What is included in the ticket price?
faqs.answer: The ticket price includes access to all of the talks and workshops, as well as food and drinks. You will also receive a Devfest Siliguri t-shirt and a swag bag.

faqs.question: Will there be food and drinks served at the event?
faqs.answer: Yes, food and drinks will be served at the event. The ticket price includes all meals and snacks.

faqs.question: Will there be networking opportunities at the event?
faqs.answer: Yes, there will be plenty of networking opportunities at the event. We will have a dedicated networking session, as well as breaks between talks and workshops where you can meet other attendees.

faqs.question: What is the dress code for Devfest Siliguri?
faqs.answer: The dress code for Devfest Siliguri is casual.
